exposure: Tele-education program based on the Health Belief Model (HBM)
cohort: The study included 149 nulliparous pregnant women randomized into an experimental group receiving tele-education and a control group.
finding: The tele-education program based on the Health Belief Model significantly increased nulliparous pregnant women's belief and tendency levels towards normal delivery.
mod_finding: The tele-education given in line with the HBM increased the belief and tendency levels of the nulliparous pregnant women towards normal delivery, encouraging normal mode of birth.
